What would you do if a masked man saw you first?
You and your big sister are stuck at a roadside motel.
But across the parking lot, the office light is on…
a man in a white mask walks in…
and the night clerk never walks out.
Then he turns… and stares at your window.
Kill the TV. Kill the lamp.
In the dark, you're just another empty room.
He took it from the office.
Never stay where he expects you.
Your sister points at the bathroom.
Behind you, the motel door bangs open.
